issue.title: ~2.2k leaked ..gate-shell-/..monitor-start-/..gate-turn- lock files accumulate in ace-run/

task_type_fields.impact: Every `ace-run/` listing (`iter_agent_artifact_dirs`, the `wait_checks` walk, TUI loaders, retention) pays for thousands of extra entries. Before sase-1hf these files were the only thing moving the waits-lane fs trigger token, which hid the blind-trigger bug (sase-1hb). Unbounded growth also costs inodes on a long-lived host.
task_type_fields.repro:
Hidden lock files accumulate directly under each project's `artifacts/ace-run/` and are never removed. Counted on athena on 2026-10-07:

    ls -a ~/.sase/projects/gh_sase-org__sase/artifacts/ace-run | grep -E '^\.\.' | sed -E 's/^\.\.([a-z-]+)-.*/\1/' | sort | uniq -c
       642 gate-shell
       173 gate-turn
      1359 monitor-start

That is 2,174 in the sase project, 187 in bob-cli, and a few elsewhere. Find the writers of the `..gate-shell-*`, `..monitor-start-*`, and `..gate-turn-*` lock files (gate shell, monitor start, and gate turn lock/claim code). Make them unlink the lock after release, or move the locks out of `ace-run/` into a state dir with retention.

Proposed by phase bead sase-1hf.5 (lane-split) in PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP note #1, item 3. Filed by the sase-1hf land agent.

issue.creation_reason: sase-1hf found these never-removed hidden lock files dominating ace-run/ listings and masking the waits-lane trigger bug; nothing cleans them up.
